sloka: यथा त्वां न प्रजानाति गच्छन्तं युद्धकाङ्क्षिणम् ।लवणस्तु मधोः पुत्रस्तथा गच्छेरशङ्कितम् ।। ७.६४.८ ॥
transliteration: yathā tvāṁ na prajānāti gacchantaṁ yuddhakāṅkṣiṇam ।lavaṇastu madhoḥ putrastathā gaccheraśaṅkitam ।। 7.64.8 ॥

translations.english: You should go without suspicion, so that Lavana, the son of Madhu, does not recognize you as one going and desiring battle.
